---
title: "TiNTS epidemiological analysis: Ct-threshold sensitivity"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: true
  message: true
editor: source
---

This document reproduces the Ct-threshold sensitivity analyses from Ct 30 to Ct 40. It reconstructs threshold-specific PCR series and episodes, repeats burden estimation, and refits the fixed first-event and recurrent-event Cox models. Plot-only sections are omitted; tabular outputs and the scenario manifest are retained.

```{r}
# ========================================================================
# Ct THRESHOLD SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — END TO END
# ========================================================================
#
# Compares alternative PCR positivity definitions:
# Ct <= 30, 32, 35, 36, 37.1 (primary), 38, 39 and 40.
#
# For each definition, the script:
#   1. Reads the saved positive-sample CSV.
#   2. Reconstructs longitudinal PCR status.
#   3. Reconstructs episodes.
#   4. Calculates duration, incidence and prevalence.
#   5. Refits the fixed final first-event Cox model.
#   6. Refits the fixed Andersen-Gill recurrent-event model.
#   7. Produces comparison tables and an archived scenario manifest.
#
# Variable selection is deliberately not rerun.
# Outputs are written beneath outputs/ct_threshold_sensitivity/.
# Primary outputs are never overwritten.
# Ct = 37.1 QC disagreement is informational and never stops the analysis.
# ========================================================================

# ========================================================================
# 0. PACKAGES
# ========================================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "here",
  "survival",
  "lubridate"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the following required package(s) before running this script: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

invisible(
  lapply(
    required_packages,
    function(package_name) {
      suppressPackageStartupMessages(
        library(package_name, character.only = TRUE)
      )
    }
  )
)


# ========================================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# ========================================================================

set.seed(1)

# Use 500 for development and 2000 for final manuscript results.
N_BOOT <- 500L
RUN_BOOTSTRAP <- TRUE

PRIMARY_CT <- 37.1
EXPECTED_CT_THRESHOLDS <- c(30, 32, 35, 36, 37.1, 38, 39, 40)

PRIMARY_EXPECTED <- list(
  n_positive_stools = 266L,
  n_positive_participants = 158L,
  n_episode_rows = 199L,
  n_observed_onset = 166L,
  n_completed = 126L,
  mean_duration_days = 3.0,
  median_duration_days = 2.0,
  incidence_per_1000_pd = 14.76
)

# ========================================================================
# 2. PATHS
# ========================================================================

sensitivity_input_dir <- here::here(
  "data_clean",
  "ct_threshold_sensitivity"
)

output_root <- here::here(
  "outputs",
  "ct_threshold_sensitivity"
)

output_tables <- file.path(output_root, "tables")
output_figures <- file.path(output_root, "figures")
output_rds <- file.path(output_root, "rds")
output_logs <- file.path(output_root, "logs")

invisible(
  lapply(
    c(output_tables, output_figures, output_rds, output_logs),
    dir.create,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )
)

# ========================================================================
# 3. GENERAL HELPERS
# ========================================================================

assert_file_exists <- function(path, description = "Input file") {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop(description, " not found: ", path, call. = FALSE)
  }
  invisible(path)
}

assert_columns <- function(dat, required_columns, object_name) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(required_columns, names(dat))

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0L) {
    stop(
      object_name,
      " is missing required column(s): ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  invisible(dat)
}

normalise_id <- function(x) {
  out <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  out[
    is.na(out) |
      out %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", ".")
  ] <- NA_character_
  out
}

normalise_text <- function(x) {
  out <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  out[
    is.na(out) |
      out %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", ".")
  ] <- NA_character_
  out
}

parse_numeric_safe <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    readr::parse_number(
      as.character(x),
      na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "na", "n/a", ".")
    )
  )
}

yes_no_numeric <- function(x, integer = FALSE) {
  x_norm <- stringr::str_to_lower(normalise_text(x))

  out <- dplyr::case_when(
    x_norm == "yes" ~ 1,
    x_norm == "no" ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )

  if (integer) {
    as.integer(out)
  } else {
    out
  }
}

# Correctly handles common day-month-year and year-month-day formats.
# Unparseable values become NA rather than stopping the analysis.
to_date_safe <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "Date")) {
    return(x)
  }

  if (inherits(x, "POSIXt")) {
    return(as.Date(x))
  }

  x_chr <- normalise_text(x)

  out <- suppressWarnings(
    lubridate::dmy(x_chr, quiet = TRUE)
  )

  bad <- !is.na(x_chr) & is.na(out)

  if (any(bad)) {
    out_ymd <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::ymd(x_chr[bad], quiet = TRUE)
    )
    out[bad] <- out_ymd
  }

  bad <- !is.na(x_chr) & is.na(out)

  if (any(bad)) {
    out_dmy_hms <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::dmy_hms(x_chr[bad], quiet = TRUE)
    )
    out[bad] <- as.Date(out_dmy_hms)
  }

  bad <- !is.na(x_chr) & is.na(out)

  if (any(bad)) {
    out_ymd_hms <- suppressWarnings(
      lubridate::ymd_hms(x_chr[bad], quiet = TRUE)
    )
    out[bad] <- as.Date(out_ymd_hms)
  }

  bad_final <- !is.na(x_chr) & is.na(out)

  if (any(bad_final)) {
    message(
      "DATE QC: ",
      sum(bad_final),
      " date value(s) could not be parsed and will be omitted. Examples: ",
      paste(head(unique(x_chr[bad_final]), 10), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  as.Date(out)
}

safe_divide <- function(num, den) {
  output_length <- max(length(num), length(den))

  if (output_length == 0L) {
    return(numeric())
  }

  num <- rep_len(as.numeric(num), output_length)
  den <- rep_len(as.numeric(den), output_length)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, output_length)
  valid <- is.finite(num) & is.finite(den) & den > 0
  out[valid] <- num[valid] / den[valid]
  out
}

relative_change_percent <- function(x, reference) {
  if (!is.finite(reference) || reference == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }

  100 * (x / reference - 1)
}

q_safe <- function(x, probability) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  if (length(x) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  as.numeric(
    stats::quantile(
      x,
      probs = probability,
      na.rm = TRUE,
      names = FALSE
    )
  )
}

safe_max <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0L) NA_real_ else max(x)
}

ct_label <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_replace(
    format(x, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
    "\\.",
    "p"
  )
}

format_range <- function(lower, upper, digits = 1L) {
  dplyr::if_else(
    is.finite(lower) & is.finite(upper),
    paste0(round(lower, digits), "–", round(upper, digits)),
    NA_character_
  )
}

format_p_value <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    !is.finite(p) ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "<0.001",
    p < 0.01 ~ sprintf("%.3f", p),
    TRUE ~ sprintf("%.2f", p)
  )
}

write_log <- function(filename, lines) {
  writeLines(
    unique(as.character(lines)),
    con = file.path(output_logs, filename),
    useBytes = TRUE
  )
}

interval_union_days <- function(start, stop) {
  x <- tibble::tibble(
    start = as.numeric(start),
    stop = as.numeric(stop)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(start),
      is.finite(stop),
      stop > start
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(start, stop)

  if (nrow(x) == 0L) {
    return(0)
  }

  current_start <- x$start[1]
  current_stop <- x$stop[1]
  total <- 0

  if (nrow(x) > 1L) {
    for (i in seq.int(2L, nrow(x))) {
      if (x$start[i] <= current_stop) {
        current_stop <- max(current_stop, x$stop[i])
      } else {
        total <- total + (current_stop - current_start)
        current_start <- x$start[i]
        current_stop <- x$stop[i]
      }
    }
  }

  total + (current_stop - current_start)
}

empty_episode_table <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    pid = character(),
    hhid = character(),
    episode_order = integer(),
    episode_id = character(),
    n_pos = integer(),
    singleton = logical(),
    first_positive = as.Date(character()),
    last_positive = as.Date(character()),
    onset_lower = as.Date(character()),
    onset_upper = as.Date(character()),
    end_lower = as.Date(character()),
    end_upper = as.Date(character())
  )
}

empty_cox_results <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    threshold = numeric(),
    model = character(),
    term = character(),
    beta = numeric(),
    robust_se = numeric(),
    HR = numeric(),
    lo = numeric(),
    hi = numeric(),
    p = numeric(),
    n_model = integer(),
    n_events = integer()
  )
}

empty_boot_results <- function() {
  tibble::tibble(
    mean_duration_days = numeric(),
    median_duration_days = numeric(),
    incidence_per_1000_person_days = numeric(),
    person_time_prevalence_percent = numeric()
  )
}

save_plot_safely <- function(plot, filename, width, height, dpi = 600) {
  target <- file.path(output_figures, filename)

  tryCatch(
    {
      ggplot2::ggsave(
        filename = target,
        plot = plot,
        width = width,
        height = height,
        dpi = dpi,
        bg = "white"
      )
      invisible(target)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      write_log(
        paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename), "_PLOT_ERROR.txt"),
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

      message(
        "Could not save ",
        filename,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        ". Attempting a PNG fallback."
      )

      fallback <- file.path(
        output_figures,
        paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename), ".png")
      )

      tryCatch(
        ggplot2::ggsave(
          filename = fallback,
          plot = plot,
          width = width,
          height = height,
          dpi = dpi,
          bg = "white"
        ),
        error = function(e2) {
          write_log(
            paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename), "_PNG_FALLBACK_ERROR.txt"),
            conditionMessage(e2)
          )
          message(
            "PNG fallback also failed: ",
            conditionMessage(e2)
          )
        }
      )

      invisible(NULL)
    }
  )
}

# ========================================================================
# 4. FIND SENSITIVITY CSVs
# ========================================================================

if (!dir.exists(sensitivity_input_dir)) {
  stop(
    "Sensitivity input directory not found: ",
    sensitivity_input_dir,
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

sensitivity_files <- list.files(
  sensitivity_input_dir,
  pattern = "^PCR_positives_Ct_le_.*_sensitivity\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(sensitivity_files) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No sensitivity CSVs found in: ",
    sensitivity_input_dir,
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

scenario_manifest <- tibble::tibble(
  sensitivity_file = sensitivity_files,
  filename = basename(sensitivity_files)
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    threshold_text = stringr::str_match(
      filename,
      "^PCR_positives_Ct_le_([0-9]+(?:[p.][0-9]+)?)_sensitivity\\.csv$"
    )[, 2],
    threshold = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(stringr::str_replace_all(threshold_text, "p", "."))
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(threshold)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(threshold)

if (nrow(scenario_manifest) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "Sensitivity CSVs were found, but no Ct threshold could be parsed from their filenames.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

duplicate_thresholds <- scenario_manifest %>%
  dplyr::count(threshold, name = "n_files") %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_files > 1L)

if (nrow(duplicate_thresholds) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "More than one sensitivity CSV was found for Ct threshold(s): ",
    paste(duplicate_thresholds$threshold, collapse = ", "),
    ". Keep exactly one file per threshold.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

missing_expected_thresholds <- setdiff(
  EXPECTED_CT_THRESHOLDS,
  scenario_manifest$threshold
)

if (length(missing_expected_thresholds) > 0L) {
  warning(
    "No sensitivity file was found for expected Ct threshold(s): ",
    paste(missing_expected_thresholds, collapse = ", "),
    ". The available thresholds will still run.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\n=============================================\n")
cat("Ct SENSITIVITY SCENARIOS\n")
cat("=============================================\n")
print(
  scenario_manifest %>% dplyr::select(threshold, filename),
  n = Inf
)

# ========================================================================
# 5. LOAD DATA
# ========================================================================

pcr_input_path <- here::here(
  "data_clean",
  "bayesian_pcr_for_epi_analysis_28052025.csv"
)

a_input_path <- here::here("data_raw", "CRF_A.csv")
b_input_path <- here::here("data_raw", "CRF_B_MCA.csv")
wealth_input_path <- here::here(
  "data_clean",
  "wealth_index_by_household.csv"
)

assert_file_exists(pcr_input_path, "Longitudinal PCR file")
assert_file_exists(a_input_path, "Household questionnaire file")
assert_file_exists(b_input_path, "Individual questionnaire file")
assert_file_exists(wealth_input_path, "Household wealth file")

CRF_PCR <- readr::read_csv(pcr_input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
A_raw <- readr::read_csv(a_input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
B_raw <- readr::read_csv(b_input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
hh_wealth <- readr::read_csv(wealth_input_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

assert_columns(
  CRF_PCR,
  c("pid", "data_date", "CT_Value"),
  "CRF_PCR"
)

assert_columns(B_raw, c("pid", "hhid"), "B_raw")

# Standardise key IDs before any joins.
CRF_PCR <- CRF_PCR %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pid = normalise_id(pid),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("hhid"), normalise_id),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("ID"), normalise_id)
  )

A_raw <- A_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("hhid"), normalise_id))

B_raw <- B_raw %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pid = normalise_id(pid),
    hhid = normalise_id(hhid)
  )

hh_wealth <- hh_wealth %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(dplyr::any_of("hhid"), normalise_id))

# ========================================================================
# 6. PREPARE LONGITUDINAL PCR DATA
# ========================================================================

if (!"hhid" %in% names(CRF_PCR)) {
  pid_hhid_lookup <- B_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, hhid) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pid), !is.na(hhid)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  ambiguous_pid_hhid <- pid_hhid_lookup %>%
    dplyr::count(pid, name = "n_hhid") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_hhid > 1L)

  if (nrow(ambiguous_pid_hhid) > 0L) {
    stop(
      "Cannot attach hhid to CRF_PCR because at least one pid maps to multiple households.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  CRF_PCR <- CRF_PCR %>%
    dplyr::left_join(pid_hhid_lookup, by = "pid")
}

pcr_master <- CRF_PCR %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    hhid = normalise_id(hhid),
    data_date = to_date_safe(data_date),
    CT_numeric = parse_numeric_safe(CT_Value)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(pid),
    !is.na(hhid),
    !is.na(data_date)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pid, data_date)

if (nrow(pcr_master) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No usable longitudinal PCR observations remain after ID and date cleaning.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\n=============================================\n")
cat("LONGITUDINAL PCR DATA\n")
cat("=============================================\n")
cat("Rows: ", nrow(pcr_master), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Participants: ", dplyr::n_distinct(pcr_master$pid), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Households: ", dplyr::n_distinct(pcr_master$hhid), "\n", sep = "")
cat(
  "Maximum numeric Ct retained in CRF_PCR: ",
  ifelse(is.finite(safe_max(pcr_master$CT_numeric)), safe_max(pcr_master$CT_numeric), "NA"),
  "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD A BROADER ID -> PARTICIPANT/DATE LOOKUP FOR HIGH-Ct POSITIVES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The primary epidemiology file was built for the Ct <= 37.1 analysis. It can
# therefore legitimately omit observations that only become positive at Ct 38,
# 39 or 40. The saved threshold-specific positive CSVs remain authoritative for
# positivity. To place any positive ID absent from pcr_master back onto the
# participant timeline, discover the broadest PCR/stool CSV in data_raw or
# data_clean that contains the SAME ID key plus pid and a collection date.
#
# This is deliberately a narrow augmentation of the original working workflow:
#   * observations already present in pcr_master are never replaced;
#   * Ct <= 37.1 therefore uses the same longitudinal frame as before;
#   * only threshold-positive IDs missing from pcr_master are added;
#   * no numerical Ct fallback is used for those missing observations.

SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES <- c(
  "ID", "stool_id", "sample_id", "sampleid", "Sample_ID", "SampleID"
)

DATE_CANDIDATES <- c(
  "data_date", "sample_date", "collection_date", "collection_dt",
  "date_collected", "Date", "date"
)

first_present <- function(nms, candidates) {
  hit <- candidates[candidates %in% nms]
  if (length(hit) == 0L) NA_character_ else hit[[1L]]
}

read_sensitivity_ids <- function(path) {
  d <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  id_col <- first_present(names(d), SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES)
  if (is.na(id_col)) {
    stop(
      "Sensitivity file has no recognised sample-ID column: ", basename(path),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  ids <- unique(normalise_id(d[[id_col]]))
  ids[!is.na(ids)]
}

all_sensitivity_positive_ids <- unique(unlist(
  purrr::map(sensitivity_files, read_sensitivity_ids),
  use.names = FALSE
))

# Coverage already available in the primary longitudinal file.
primary_id_col <- first_present(names(pcr_master), SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES)

if (is.na(primary_id_col)) {
  stop(
    "The longitudinal PCR dataset has no recognised sample-ID column. ",
    "Expected one of: ", paste(SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

pcr_master <- pcr_master %>%
  dplyr::mutate(.analysis_id = normalise_id(.data[[primary_id_col]]))

primary_id_coverage <- length(intersect(
  all_sensitivity_positive_ids,
  unique(pcr_master$.analysis_id)
))

# Candidate source files. Restrict discovery to PCR/stool-looking CSVs to avoid
# accidentally using an unrelated table that happens to contain ID and pid.
candidate_dirs <- c(here::here("data_raw"), here::here("data_clean"))
candidate_dirs <- candidate_dirs[dir.exists(candidate_dirs)]

candidate_csvs <- unique(unlist(
  lapply(candidate_dirs, function(d) {
    list.files(d, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  }),
  use.names = FALSE
))

candidate_csvs <- candidate_csvs[
  stringr::str_detect(
    stringr::str_to_lower(basename(candidate_csvs)),
    "pcr|stool"
  )
]

# The sensitivity outputs themselves are positive-only files, so exclude them
# from automatic lookup discovery unless they happen to contain full metadata;
# they are handled separately within make_threshold_pcr().
candidate_csvs <- setdiff(
  normalizePath(candidate_csvs, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE),
  normalizePath(sensitivity_files, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
)

inspect_lookup_candidate <- function(path) {
  hdr <- tryCatch(
    names(readr::read_csv(path, n_max = 0, show_col_types = FALSE)),
    error = function(e) character()
  )

  id_col <- first_present(hdr, SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES)
  pid_col <- first_present(hdr, c("pid", "PID", "participant_id", "participantid"))
  date_col <- first_present(hdr, DATE_CANDIDATES)

  if (is.na(id_col) || is.na(pid_col) || is.na(date_col)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(
      path = path,
      id_col = id_col,
      pid_col = pid_col,
      date_col = date_col,
      overlap = -1L,
      n_unique_ids = NA_integer_
    ))
  }

  ids <- tryCatch(
    {
      x <- readr::read_csv(
        path,
        col_select = dplyr::all_of(id_col),
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        progress = FALSE
      )[[id_col]]
      unique(normalise_id(x))
    },
    error = function(e) character()
  )
  ids <- ids[!is.na(ids)]

  tibble::tibble(
    path = path,
    id_col = id_col,
    pid_col = pid_col,
    date_col = date_col,
    overlap = length(intersect(all_sensitivity_positive_ids, ids)),
    n_unique_ids = length(ids)
  )
}

lookup_candidate_qc <- if (length(candidate_csvs) > 0L) {
  purrr::map_dfr(candidate_csvs, inspect_lookup_candidate)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(
    path = character(), id_col = character(), pid_col = character(),
    date_col = character(), overlap = integer(), n_unique_ids = integer()
  )
}

if (nrow(lookup_candidate_qc) > 0L) {
  lookup_candidate_qc <- lookup_candidate_qc %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(overlap), dplyr::desc(n_unique_ids))
}

readr::write_csv(
  lookup_candidate_qc,
  file.path(output_tables, "PCR_LONGITUDINAL_LOOKUP_CANDIDATE_QC.csv")
)

best_lookup <- if (nrow(lookup_candidate_qc) > 0L) {
  lookup_candidate_qc %>%
    dplyr::filter(overlap >= 0L) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
} else {
  tibble::tibble()
}

full_positive_lookup <- pcr_master %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    .analysis_id,
    pid,
    hhid,
    data_date,
    lookup_source = "primary longitudinal file"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(.analysis_id)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

if (nrow(best_lookup) > 0L && best_lookup$overlap[[1L]] > primary_id_coverage) {
  lookup_raw <- readr::read_csv(
    best_lookup$path[[1L]],
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE
  )

  lookup_id_col <- best_lookup$id_col[[1L]]
  lookup_pid_col <- best_lookup$pid_col[[1L]]
  lookup_date_col <- best_lookup$date_col[[1L]]
  lookup_hhid_col <- first_present(names(lookup_raw), c("hhid", "HHID", "household_id"))

  extra_lookup <- tibble::tibble(
    .analysis_id = normalise_id(lookup_raw[[lookup_id_col]]),
    pid = normalise_id(lookup_raw[[lookup_pid_col]]),
    data_date = to_date_safe(lookup_raw[[lookup_date_col]]),
    hhid_source = if (!is.na(lookup_hhid_col)) {
      normalise_id(lookup_raw[[lookup_hhid_col]])
    } else {
      rep(NA_character_, nrow(lookup_raw))
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(.analysis_id),
      !is.na(pid),
      !is.na(data_date)
    )

  # Use CRF_B as the authoritative household crosswalk where needed.
  pid_hhid_crosswalk <- B_raw %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, hhid) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(pid), !is.na(hhid)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  extra_lookup <- extra_lookup %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      pid_hhid_crosswalk %>% dplyr::rename(hhid_from_B = hhid),
      by = "pid"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(hhid = dplyr::coalesce(hhid_source, hhid_from_B)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(hhid)) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      .analysis_id,
      pid,
      hhid,
      data_date,
      lookup_source = basename(best_lookup$path[[1L]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  full_positive_lookup <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    full_positive_lookup,
    extra_lookup
  ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(.analysis_id, pid, hhid, data_date, .keep_all = TRUE)

  message(
    "High-Ct observation lookup: using ",
    best_lookup$path[[1L]],
    " (matches ", best_lookup$overlap[[1L]],
    " of ", length(all_sensitivity_positive_ids),
    " threshold-positive IDs; primary longitudinal file matches ",
    primary_id_coverage, ")."
  )
} else {
  message(
    "No broader PCR/stool lookup improved on the primary longitudinal ID coverage. ",
    "The sensitivity CSV metadata will be used directly for missing positives where possible."
  )
}

# Audit ID multiplicity in the combined lookup. This is informational only;
# ambiguity is evaluated only for IDs that actually need to be added.
positive_lookup_qc <- full_positive_lookup %>%
  dplyr::group_by(.analysis_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_pid = dplyr::n_distinct(pid),
    n_hhid = dplyr::n_distinct(hhid),
    n_dates = dplyr::n_distinct(data_date),
    n_mappings = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_mappings), .analysis_id)

readr::write_csv(
  positive_lookup_qc,
  file.path(output_tables, "PCR_POSITIVE_ID_LOOKUP_QC.csv")
)

# ========================================================================
# 11. BUILD THRESHOLD-SPECIFIC LONGITUDINAL PCR SERIES
# ========================================================================
# Preferred method: where both datasets contain ID, use the saved positive
# IDs directly. Fallback: apply the numerical threshold to longitudinal Ct.
# QC discrepancies are logged but never stop the analysis.

make_threshold_pcr <- function(sensitivity_file, threshold) {
  sens_positive <- readr::read_csv(
    sensitivity_file,
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  expected_positive_rows <- nrow(sens_positive)
  sens_id_col <- first_present(names(sens_positive), SENSITIVITY_ID_CANDIDATES)

  if (is.na(sens_id_col)) {
    stop(
      "Ct <= ", threshold,
      ": sensitivity CSV has no recognised sample-ID column.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  positive_ids <- unique(normalise_id(sens_positive[[sens_id_col]]))
  positive_ids <- positive_ids[!is.na(positive_ids)]

  if (length(positive_ids) == 0L) {
    stop(
      "Ct <= ", threshold,
      ": sensitivity CSV contains no usable positive IDs.",
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Preserve the original working longitudinal series exactly.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  base <- pcr_master %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .analysis_id = normalise_id(.analysis_id),
      CT_text_observed = normalise_text(CT_Value),
      pcr_observed = !is.na(CT_text_observed) | .analysis_id %in% positive_ids,
      pcr_pos = as.integer(.analysis_id %in% positive_ids)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(pcr_observed) %>%
    dplyr::select(pid, hhid, data_date, .analysis_id, pcr_pos)

  base_positive_ids <- unique(base$.analysis_id[base$pcr_pos == 1L])
  missing_positive_ids <- setdiff(positive_ids, base_positive_ids)

  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Add ONLY threshold-positive observations absent from the primary
  #    Ct<=37.1 longitudinal file.
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  extra_positive_rows <- tibble::tibble(
    pid = character(),
    hhid = character(),
    data_date = as.Date(character()),
    .analysis_id = character(),
    pcr_pos = integer()
  )

  if (length(missing_positive_ids) > 0L) {
    # First attempt: use the broader automatically discovered PCR/stool lookup.
    extra_lookup <- full_positive_lookup %>%
      dplyr::filter(.analysis_id %in% missing_positive_ids) %>%
      dplyr::select(.analysis_id, pid, hhid, data_date) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    # Second attempt: if a missing ID is still absent, use participant/date
    # metadata carried inside the positive sensitivity CSV itself.
    still_missing <- setdiff(
      missing_positive_ids,
      unique(extra_lookup$.analysis_id)
    )

    if (length(still_missing) > 0L) {
      sens_pid_col <- first_present(
        names(sens_positive),
        c("pid", "PID", "participant_id", "participantid")
      )
      sens_date_col <- first_present(names(sens_positive), DATE_CANDIDATES)
      sens_hhid_col <- first_present(
        names(sens_positive),
        c("hhid", "HHID", "household_id")
      )

      if (!is.na(sens_pid_col) && !is.na(sens_date_col)) {
        sens_extra <- tibble::tibble(
          .analysis_id = normalise_id(sens_positive[[sens_id_col]]),
          pid = normalise_id(sens_positive[[sens_pid_col]]),
          data_date = to_date_safe(sens_positive[[sens_date_col]]),
          hhid_source = if (!is.na(sens_hhid_col)) {
            normalise_id(sens_positive[[sens_hhid_col]])
          } else {
            rep(NA_character_, nrow(sens_positive))
          }
        ) %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            .analysis_id %in% still_missing,
            !is.na(pid),
            !is.na(data_date)
          )

        pid_hhid_crosswalk <- B_raw %>%
          dplyr::select(pid, hhid) %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(pid), !is.na(hhid)) %>%
          dplyr::distinct()

        sens_extra <- sens_extra %>%
          dplyr::left_join(
            pid_hhid_crosswalk %>% dplyr::rename(hhid_from_B = hhid),
            by = "pid"
          ) %>%
          dplyr::mutate(hhid = dplyr::coalesce(hhid_source, hhid_from_B)) %>%
          dplyr::filter(!is.na(hhid)) %>%
          dplyr::select(.analysis_id, pid, hhid, data_date) %>%
          dplyr::distinct()

        extra_lookup <- dplyr::bind_rows(extra_lookup, sens_extra) %>%
          dplyr::distinct(.analysis_id, pid, hhid, data_date)
      }
    }

    # An ID that maps to exactly duplicated technical rows is fine after
    # distinct(). An ID that genuinely maps to >1 participant/date is written
    # to QC and, rather than poisoning every scenario, only that ID is omitted
    # from temporal augmentation with an explicit warning. This preserves the
    # original working analysis while making ambiguity visible.
    mapping_counts <- extra_lookup %>%
      dplyr::count(.analysis_id, name = "n_mappings")

    ambiguous_ids <- mapping_counts %>%
      dplyr::filter(n_mappings > 1L) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.analysis_id)

    if (length(ambiguous_ids) > 0L) {
      readr::write_csv(
        extra_lookup %>% dplyr::filter(.analysis_id %in% ambiguous_ids),
        file.path(
          output_tables,
          paste0("Ct_", ct_label(threshold), "_AMBIGUOUS_EXTRA_POSITIVE_IDS.csv")
        )
      )

      warning(
        "Ct <= ", threshold, ": ", length(ambiguous_ids),
        " missing positive ID(s) had multiple participant/date mappings and ",
        "could not be added safely. See threshold-specific QC. The scenario ",
        "will continue, but the missing-ID count must be zero before final ",
        "primary-analysis interpretation.",
        call. = FALSE
      )

      extra_lookup <- extra_lookup %>%
        dplyr::filter(!.analysis_id %in% ambiguous_ids)
    }

    extra_positive_rows <- extra_lookup %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        pid,
        hhid,
        data_date,
        .analysis_id,
        pcr_pos = 1L
      )
  }

  out_sample <- dplyr::bind_rows(base, extra_positive_rows)

  # Collapse technical duplicates on the same participant-day. A day is
  # positive if any contributing record is positive.
  out <- out_sample %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pid, hhid, data_date) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      pcr_pos = as.integer(any(pcr_pos == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(pid, data_date)

  represented_positive_ids <- unique(out_sample$.analysis_id[out_sample$pcr_pos == 1L])
  unresolved_positive_ids <- setdiff(positive_ids, represented_positive_ids)

  if (length(unresolved_positive_ids) > 0L) {
    writeLines(
      unresolved_positive_ids,
      file.path(
        output_logs,
        paste0(
          "Ct_", ct_label(threshold),
          "_UNRESOLVED_POSITIVE_IDS.txt"
        )
      )
    )
  }

  observed_positive_days <- sum(out$pcr_pos == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)

  message(
    "Ct <= ", threshold,
    " | saved positive rows = ", expected_positive_rows,
    " | unique saved positive IDs = ", length(positive_ids),
    " | positives already in primary longitudinal file = ", length(base_positive_ids),
    " | extra positive observation rows added = ", nrow(extra_positive_rows),
    " | unresolved positive IDs = ", length(unresolved_positive_ids),
    " | reconstructed positive participant-days = ", observed_positive_days
  )

  qc <- tibble::tibble(
    threshold = threshold,
    sensitivity_file = basename(sensitivity_file),
    sensitivity_id_column = sens_id_col,
    longitudinal_id_column = primary_id_col,
    saved_positive_rows = expected_positive_rows,
    saved_unique_positive_ids = length(positive_ids),
    positive_ids_present_in_primary_longitudinal = length(base_positive_ids),
    positive_ids_missing_from_primary_longitudinal = length(missing_positive_ids),
    extra_positive_rows_added = nrow(extra_positive_rows),
    unresolved_positive_ids = length(unresolved_positive_ids),
    reconstructed_positive_participant_days = observed_positive_days,
    method = paste0(
      "original longitudinal series + saved positive-ID augmentation from broader PCR/stool lookup; ",
      "no high-Ct numeric fallback"
    )
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    qc,
    file.path(
      output_tables,
      paste0("Ct_", ct_label(threshold), "_PCR_input_QC.csv")
    )
  )

  out
}

# ========================================================================
# 12. BUILD EPISODES
# ========================================================================
# Successive positives remain in one episode unless separated by at least
# two observed PCR-negative stools. Onset is bounded where the immediately
# preceding two observations are negative. Offset is observed where the
# immediately following two observations are negative.

build_one_person_episodes <- function(d) {
  d <- d %>% dplyr::arrange(data_date)
  positive_idx <- which(d$pcr_pos == 1L)

  if (length(positive_idx) == 0L) {
    return(empty_episode_table())
  }

  episode_group <- integer(length(positive_idx))
  episode_group[1] <- 1L

  if (length(positive_idx) > 1L) {
    current_group <- 1L

    for (k in seq.int(2L, length(positive_idx))) {
      previous_positive_index <- positive_idx[k - 1L]
      current_positive_index <- positive_idx[k]

      between_indices <- if (
        current_positive_index > previous_positive_index + 1L
      ) {
        seq.int(
          previous_positive_index + 1L,
          current_positive_index - 1L
        )
      } else {
        integer(0)
      }

      n_negative_between <- if (length(between_indices) > 0L) {
        sum(d$pcr_pos[between_indices] == 0L, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        0L
      }

      if (n_negative_between >= 2L) {
        current_group <- current_group + 1L
      }

      episode_group[k] <- current_group
    }
  }

  purrr::map_dfr(
    sort(unique(episode_group)),
    function(g) {
      idx <- positive_idx[episode_group == g]
      first_idx <- min(idx)
      last_idx <- max(idx)

      first_positive <- d$data_date[first_idx]
      last_positive <- d$data_date[last_idx]

      onset_lower <- as.Date(NA_character_)

      if (first_idx >= 3L) {
        previous_two <- d$pcr_pos[seq.int(first_idx - 2L, first_idx - 1L)]

        if (length(previous_two) == 2L && all(previous_two == 0L)) {
          onset_lower <- d$data_date[first_idx - 1L]
        }
      }

      onset_upper <- first_positive
      end_lower <- as.Date(NA_character_)
      end_upper <- as.Date(NA_character_)

      if (last_idx + 2L <= nrow(d)) {
        following_two <- d$pcr_pos[seq.int(last_idx + 1L, last_idx + 2L)]

        if (length(following_two) == 2L && all(following_two == 0L)) {
          end_lower <- d$data_date[last_idx + 1L]
          end_upper <- d$data_date[last_idx + 2L]
        }
      }

      tibble::tibble(
        pid = d$pid[1],
        hhid = d$hhid[1],
        episode_order = as.integer(g),
        episode_id = paste0(d$pid[1], "_E", g),
        n_pos = as.integer(length(idx)),
        singleton = length(idx) == 1L,
        first_positive = first_positive,
        last_positive = last_positive,
        onset_lower = onset_lower,
        onset_upper = onset_upper,
        end_lower = end_lower,
        end_upper = end_upper
      )
    }
  )
}

build_episodes <- function(pcr_df) {
  if (nrow(pcr_df) == 0L) {
    return(empty_episode_table())
  }

  out <- pcr_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pid, hhid) %>%
    dplyr::group_split(.keep = TRUE) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(
      function(d) {
        tryCatch(
          build_one_person_episodes(d),
          error = function(e) {
            message(
              "Episode construction failed for pid ",
              paste(unique(d$pid), collapse = ", "),
              ": ",
              conditionMessage(e),
              ". Continuing."
            )
            empty_episode_table()
          }
        )
      }
    )

  if (nrow(out) == 0L) {
    return(empty_episode_table())
  }

  out %>% dplyr::arrange(pid, episode_order)
}

# ========================================================================
# 13. BURDEN / DURATION ANALYSIS
# ========================================================================

calculate_burden <- function(
    pcr_df,
    episodes_df,
    followup_df,
    threshold,
    padding_days = 1,
    n_boot = N_BOOT,
    run_bootstrap = RUN_BOOTSTRAP) {

  followup_chapter <- followup_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      first_obs = to_date_safe(first_obs),
      last_obs = to_date_safe(last_obs),
      first_obs_num = as.numeric(first_obs),
      last_obs_num = as.numeric(last_obs),
      followup_days = as.numeric(last_obs - first_obs)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(followup_days),
      followup_days > 0
    )

  episodes_base <- episodes_df %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      followup_chapter %>%
        dplyr::select(
          pid,
          hhid,
          first_obs,
          last_obs,
          first_obs_num,
          last_obs_num
        ),
      by = c("pid", "hhid")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      observed_onset = !is.na(onset_lower) & !is.na(onset_upper),
      observed_offset = !is.na(end_upper),
      closed_episode = observed_onset & observed_offset,
      episode_row_id = dplyr::row_number()
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Non-at-risk windows
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  nonrisk_windows <- episodes_base %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      nonrisk_start_num = dplyr::case_when(
        observed_onset ~ pmax(
          as.numeric(onset_upper) - padding_days,
          first_obs_num
        ),
        !observed_onset ~ first_obs_num,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      nonrisk_stop_num = dplyr::case_when(
        observed_offset ~ pmin(
          as.numeric(end_upper),
          last_obs_num
        ),
        !observed_offset ~ last_obs_num,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(nonrisk_start_num),
      is.finite(nonrisk_stop_num),
      nonrisk_stop_num > nonrisk_start_num
    )

  nonrisk_by_pid <- nonrisk_windows %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pid, hhid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      not_at_risk_days = interval_union_days(
        nonrisk_start_num,
        nonrisk_stop_num
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Completed-episode duration
  # onset = first positive - 1 day; offset = final positive + 1 day.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  duration_episode_df <- episodes_base %>%
    dplyr::filter(closed_episode) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      duration_start_num = pmax(
        as.numeric(first_positive) - padding_days,
        first_obs_num
      ),
      duration_stop_num = pmin(
        as.numeric(last_positive) + padding_days,
        as.numeric(end_upper),
        last_obs_num
      ),
      duration_days = duration_stop_num - duration_start_num,
      duration_start = as.Date(
        duration_start_num,
        origin = "1970-01-01"
      ),
      duration_stop = as.Date(
        duration_stop_num,
        origin = "1970-01-01"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(duration_days),
      duration_days > 0
    )

  closed_days_by_pid <- duration_episode_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pid, hhid) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      closed_episode_days = interval_union_days(
        duration_start_num,
        duration_stop_num
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  incidence_by_pid <- duration_episode_df %>%
    dplyr::count(pid, hhid, name = "n_incidence_episodes")

  person_time_df <- followup_chapter %>%
    dplyr::left_join(nonrisk_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(closed_days_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(incidence_by_pid, by = c("pid", "hhid")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      not_at_risk_days = tidyr::replace_na(not_at_risk_days, 0),
      closed_episode_days = tidyr::replace_na(closed_episode_days, 0),
      n_incidence_episodes = tidyr::replace_na(
        n_incidence_episodes,
        0L
      ),
      at_risk_days = pmax(
        followup_days - not_at_risk_days,
        0
      ),
      prevalence_denominator_days = at_risk_days + closed_episode_days
    )

  n_positive_stools <- sum(pcr_df$pcr_pos == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
  positive_rows <- pcr_df %>% dplyr::filter(pcr_pos == 1L)
  n_positive_participants <- dplyr::n_distinct(positive_rows$pid)
  n_positive_households <- dplyr::n_distinct(positive_rows$hhid)

  durations <- duration_episode_df$duration_days
  total_at_risk_days <- sum(person_time_df$at_risk_days, na.rm = TRUE)
  total_episode_days <- sum(
    person_time_df$closed_episode_days,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  prevalence_denominator <- sum(
    person_time_df$prevalence_denominator_days,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  burden_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    threshold = threshold,
    n_pcr_observations = nrow(pcr_df),
    n_positive_stools = n_positive_stools,
    percent_stools_positive = safe_divide(
      n_positive_stools,
      nrow(pcr_df)
    ) * 100,
    n_positive_participants = n_positive_participants,
    n_positive_households = n_positive_households,
    n_episode_rows = nrow(episodes_base),
    n_observed_onset = sum(
      episodes_base$observed_onset,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_completed_episodes = nrow(duration_episode_df),
    n_right_censored_observed_onset = sum(
      episodes_base$observed_onset & !episodes_base$observed_offset,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_left_censored = sum(
      !episodes_base$observed_onset,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mean_duration_days = if (
      length(durations) > 0L
    ) {
      mean(durations, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    median_duration_days = if (
      length(durations) > 0L
    ) {
      stats::median(durations, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    q1_duration_days = q_safe(durations, 0.25),
    q3_duration_days = q_safe(durations, 0.75),
    total_episode_days = total_episode_days,
    total_at_risk_days = total_at_risk_days,
    incidence_per_1000_person_days = safe_divide(
      nrow(duration_episode_df),
      total_at_risk_days
    ) * 1000,
    person_time_prevalence_percent = safe_divide(
      total_episode_days,
      prevalence_denominator
    ) * 100,
    mean_duration_ci_low = NA_real_,
    mean_duration_ci_high = NA_real_,
    median_duration_ci_low = NA_real_,
    median_duration_ci_high = NA_real_,
    incidence_ci_low = NA_real_,
    incidence_ci_high = NA_real_,
    prevalence_ci_low = NA_real_,
    prevalence_ci_high = NA_real_
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Household bootstrap
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  boot_results <- empty_boot_results()
  cluster_ids <- unique(person_time_df$hhid[!is.na(person_time_df$hhid)])

  if (
    isTRUE(run_bootstrap) &&
      n_boot > 0L &&
      nrow(person_time_df) > 0L &&
      length(cluster_ids) > 0L
  ) {
    bootstrap_once <- function(i) {
      sampled_clusters <- sample(
        cluster_ids,
        length(cluster_ids),
        replace = TRUE
      )

      person_boot <- purrr::map_dfr(
        seq_along(sampled_clusters),
        function(j) {
          person_time_df %>%
            dplyr::filter(hhid == sampled_clusters[j]) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(bootstrap_cluster = j)
        }
      )

      episode_boot <- purrr::map_dfr(
        seq_along(sampled_clusters),
        function(j) {
          duration_episode_df %>%
            dplyr::filter(hhid == sampled_clusters[j]) %>%
            dplyr::mutate(bootstrap_cluster = j)
        }
      )

      boot_duration <- episode_boot$duration_days
      boot_at_risk <- sum(person_boot$at_risk_days, na.rm = TRUE)
      boot_episode_days <- sum(
        person_boot$closed_episode_days,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
      boot_prev_den <- sum(
        person_boot$prevalence_denominator_days,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      tibble::tibble(
        mean_duration_days = if (
          length(boot_duration) > 0L
        ) {
          mean(boot_duration, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },
        median_duration_days = if (
          length(boot_duration) > 0L
        ) {
          stats::median(boot_duration, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          NA_real_
        },
        incidence_per_1000_person_days = safe_divide(
          nrow(episode_boot),
          boot_at_risk
        ) * 1000,
        person_time_prevalence_percent = safe_divide(
          boot_episode_days,
          boot_prev_den
        ) * 100
      )
    }

    boot_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
      seq_len(as.integer(n_boot)),
      function(i) {
        tryCatch(
          bootstrap_once(i),
          error = function(e) {
            tibble::tibble(
              mean_duration_days = NA_real_,
              median_duration_days = NA_real_,
              incidence_per_1000_person_days = NA_real_,
              person_time_prevalence_percent = NA_real_
            )
          }
        )
      }
    )

    summarise_boot_ci <- function(variable) {
      x <- boot_results[[variable]]
      x <- x[is.finite(x)]

      if (length(x) == 0L) {
        return(c(low = NA_real_, high = NA_real_))
      }

      c(
        low = as.numeric(
          stats::quantile(
            x,
            probs = 0.025,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        ),
        high = as.numeric(
          stats::quantile(
            x,
            probs = 0.975,
            na.rm = TRUE,
            names = FALSE
          )
        )
      )
    }

    ci_mean <- summarise_boot_ci("mean_duration_days")
    ci_median <- summarise_boot_ci("median_duration_days")
    ci_incidence <- summarise_boot_ci(
      "incidence_per_1000_person_days"
    )
    ci_prevalence <- summarise_boot_ci(
      "person_time_prevalence_percent"
    )

    burden_summary <- burden_summary %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        mean_duration_ci_low = unname(ci_mean["low"]),
        mean_duration_ci_high = unname(ci_mean["high"]),
        median_duration_ci_low = unname(ci_median["low"]),
        median_duration_ci_high = unname(ci_median["high"]),
        incidence_ci_low = unname(ci_incidence["low"]),
        incidence_ci_high = unname(ci_incidence["high"]),
        prevalence_ci_low = unname(ci_prevalence["low"]),
        prevalence_ci_high = unname(ci_prevalence["high"])
      )
  }

  list(
    burden_summary = burden_summary,
    episodes_base = episodes_base,
    duration_episode_df = duration_episode_df,
    person_time_df = person_time_df,
    boot_results = boot_results
  )
}
# ========================================================================
# 14. COX HELPERS
# ========================================================================

get_estimable_covariates <- function(dat, candidate_terms) {
  terms <- intersect(candidate_terms, names(dat))

  if (length(terms) == 0L || nrow(dat) == 0L) {
    return(character())
  }

  # Re-evaluate after complete-case restriction until the retained term set
  # is stable. This prevents a factor collapsing to one level only after
  # another incomplete covariate has removed rows.
  repeat {
    complete_rows <- stats::complete.cases(dat[, terms, drop = FALSE])
    dat_complete <- dat[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(dat_complete) == 0L) {
      return(character())
    }

    keep <- vapply(
      terms,
      function(v) {
        x <- dat_complete[[v]]
        x <- x[!is.na(x)]
        length(x) > 0L && dplyr::n_distinct(x) >= 2L
      },
      logical(1)
    )

    new_terms <- terms[keep]

    if (identical(new_terms, terms)) {
      return(terms)
    }

    terms <- new_terms

    if (length(terms) == 0L) {
      return(character())
    }
  }
}

prepare_cox_data <- function(dat, candidate_terms, cluster_variable) {
  assert_columns(
    dat,
    c("tstart_num", "tstop_num", "event", cluster_variable),
    "Cox analysis dataset"
  )

  base_dat <- dat %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(tstart_num),
      is.finite(tstop_num),
      tstop_num > tstart_num,
      !is.na(event),
      !is.na(.data[[cluster_variable]])
    )

  terms <- get_estimable_covariates(base_dat, candidate_terms)

  if (length(terms) > 0L) {
    analysis_dat <- base_dat %>%
      tidyr::drop_na(dplyr::all_of(terms)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        dplyr::across(
          dplyr::all_of(terms),
          function(x) {
            if (is.character(x)) factor(x) else x
          }
        ),
        dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.factor), forcats::fct_drop)
      )

    # One final check after factor conversion and listwise deletion.
    terms <- get_estimable_covariates(analysis_dat, terms)

    if (length(terms) > 0L) {
      analysis_dat <- analysis_dat %>%
        tidyr::drop_na(dplyr::all_of(terms)) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.factor), forcats::fct_drop)
        )
    }
  } else {
    analysis_dat <- base_dat
  }

  list(data = analysis_dat, covariates = terms)
}

build_cox_formula <- function(covariates) {
  if (length(covariates) == 0L) {
    stats::as.formula(
      "survival::Surv(tstart_num, tstop_num, event) ~ 1"
    )
  } else {
    stats::reformulate(
      termlabels = covariates,
      response = "survival::Surv(tstart_num, tstop_num, event)"
    )
  }
}

extract_cox_results <- function(fit, threshold, model_name) {
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(empty_cox_results())
  }

  s <- summary(fit)
  co <- as.data.frame(s$coefficients, check.names = FALSE)

  if (nrow(co) == 0L) {
    return(empty_cox_results())
  }

  se_col <- if ("robust se" %in% names(co)) {
    "robust se"
  } else if ("se(coef)" %in% names(co)) {
    "se(coef)"
  } else {
    stop("No standard-error column was found in the Cox model summary.")
  }

  p_col <- grep("^Pr\\(", names(co), value = TRUE)
  p_values <- if (length(p_col) > 0L) {
    as.numeric(co[[p_col[1]]])
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, nrow(co))
  }

  beta <- as.numeric(co[["coef"]])
  robust_se <- as.numeric(co[[se_col]])
  term_names <- rownames(co)

  if (is.null(term_names) || length(term_names) != nrow(co)) {
    term_names <- paste0("term_", seq_len(nrow(co)))
  }

  n_model <- if (!is.null(fit$n)) as.integer(fit$n) else NA_integer_
  n_events <- if (!is.null(fit$nevent)) {
    as.integer(fit$nevent)
  } else {
    NA_integer_
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    threshold = rep(threshold, nrow(co)),
    model = rep(model_name, nrow(co)),
    term = term_names,
    beta = beta,
    robust_se = robust_se,
    HR = exp(beta),
    lo = exp(beta - 1.96 * robust_se),
    hi = exp(beta + 1.96 * robust_se),
    p = p_values,
    n_model = rep(n_model, nrow(co)),
    n_events = rep(n_events, nrow(co))
  )
}

fit_cox_safely <- function(
    analysis_data,
    formula,
    cluster_variable,
    threshold,
    model_stub,
    model_name) {

  if (nrow(analysis_data) == 0L) {
    stop("No analysable rows remain after data preparation.")
  }

  if (sum(analysis_data$event == 1L, na.rm = TRUE) == 0L) {
    stop("No events remain in the model dataset.")
  }

  if (dplyr::n_distinct(analysis_data[[cluster_variable]]) < 2L) {
    stop("Fewer than two independent clusters remain in the model dataset.")
  }

  analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      .cluster_id_internal = .data[[cluster_variable]]
    )

  warning_log <- character()

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    survival::coxph(
      formula = formula,
      data = analysis_data,
      ties = "efron",
      cluster = .cluster_id_internal,
      model = TRUE,
      x = TRUE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      warning_log <<- c(warning_log, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    }
  )

  if (length(warning_log) > 0L) {
    write_log(
      paste0(
        "Ct_",
        ct_label(threshold),
        "_",
        model_stub,
        "_warnings.txt"
      ),
      warning_log
    )
  }

  list(
    fit = fit,
    results = extract_cox_results(fit, threshold, model_name)
  )
}

# ========================================================================
# 15. FIRST-EVENT COX MODEL
# ========================================================================
# Event interval: onset_lower -> onset_upper.
# Censor interval: first_obs -> last_obs.
# Participants positive at baseline (left-censored first episode) are
# excluded rather than incorrectly treated as event-free censored subjects.
# Robust standard errors are clustered by household.

fit_first_event_model <- function(episodes_df, followup_df, threshold) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      left_censored_first_pids <- episodes_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          episode_order == 1L,
          is.na(onset_lower) | is.na(onset_upper)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(pid)

      eligible_followup <- followup_df %>%
        dplyr::anti_join(left_censored_first_pids, by = "pid")

      events_first <- episodes_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          episode_order == 1L,
          !is.na(onset_lower),
          !is.na(onset_upper)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          pid,
          hhid,
          tstart = onset_lower,
          tstop = onset_upper,
          event = 1L
        )

      censors <- eligible_followup %>%
        dplyr::anti_join(
          events_first %>% dplyr::distinct(pid),
          by = "pid"
        ) %>%
        dplyr::transmute(
          pid,
          hhid,
          tstart = first_obs,
          tstop = last_obs,
          event = 0L
        )

      selection_threshold <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        events_first,
        censors
      ) %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          covariate_df,
          by = c("pid", "hhid")
        )

      if (nrow(selection_threshold) == 0L) {
        stop("No eligible first-event or censoring records are available.")
      }

      study_start <- min(selection_threshold$tstart, na.rm = TRUE)

      if (!is.finite(as.numeric(study_start))) {
        stop("A valid study start date could not be determined.")
      }

      selection_threshold <- selection_threshold %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          tstart_num = as.numeric(tstart - study_start),
          tstop_num = as.numeric(tstop - study_start)
        )

      prepared <- prepare_cox_data(
        selection_threshold,
        final_covariates,
        cluster_variable = "hhid"
      )

      if (length(prepared$covariates) == 0L) {
        stop("No final-model covariates are estimable in the first-event data.")
      }

      formula_first <- build_cox_formula(prepared$covariates)

      fitted <- fit_cox_safely(
        analysis_data = prepared$data,
        formula = formula_first,
        cluster_variable = "hhid",
        threshold = threshold,
        model_stub = "first_event",
        model_name = "First event"
      )

      list(
        fit = fitted$fit,
        data = prepared$data,
        results = fitted$results
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Ct ",
        threshold,
        ": first-event Cox model failed: ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        ". Continuing."
      )

      write_log(
        paste0(
          "Ct_",
          ct_label(threshold),
          "_first_event_ERROR.txt"
        ),
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

      list(
        fit = NULL,
        data = tibble::tibble(),
        results = empty_cox_results()
      )
    }
  )
}

# ========================================================================
# 16. ANDERSEN-GILL RECURRENT-EVENT MODEL
# ========================================================================
# Total-time counting-process implementation. Only episodes with observed
# onset are counted as incident events. A left-censored baseline episode is
# not counted, and follow-up restarts after its observed offset. Participants
# are removed from the risk set during an episode. Follow-up after the final
# completed episode is correctly censored at last_obs.
# Robust standard errors are clustered by participant.

build_one_person_ag_intervals <- function(followup_row, person_episodes) {
  pid_value <- followup_row$pid[1]
  hhid_value <- followup_row$hhid[1]
  first_obs <- followup_row$first_obs[1]
  last_obs <- followup_row$last_obs[1]

  if (
    is.na(first_obs) ||
      is.na(last_obs) ||
      last_obs <= first_obs
  ) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(
        pid = character(),
        hhid = character(),
        tstart_num = numeric(),
        tstop_num = numeric(),
        event = integer()
      )
    )
  }

  person_episodes <- person_episodes %>%
    dplyr::arrange(episode_order)

  interval_rows <- list()
  row_index <- 0L
  risk_start <- first_obs
  risk_open <- TRUE

  if (nrow(person_episodes) > 0L) {
    for (episode_index in seq_len(nrow(person_episodes))) {
      episode <- person_episodes[episode_index, , drop = FALSE]
      observed_onset <- !is.na(episode$onset_lower) &&
        !is.na(episode$onset_upper)
      observed_offset <- !is.na(episode$end_upper)

      if (!observed_onset) {
        # Baseline/left-censored positivity contributes no incident event.
        if (observed_offset && episode$end_upper < last_obs) {
          risk_start <- max(risk_start, episode$end_upper)
          risk_open <- TRUE
        } else {
          risk_open <- FALSE
          break
        }
        next
      }

      event_stop <- min(episode$onset_upper, last_obs)

      if (risk_open && event_stop > risk_start) {
        row_index <- row_index + 1L
        interval_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
          pid = pid_value,
          hhid = hhid_value,
          tstart_num = as.numeric(risk_start - first_obs),
          tstop_num = as.numeric(event_stop - first_obs),
          event = 1L
        )
      }

      if (observed_offset && episode$end_upper < last_obs) {
        risk_start <- max(event_stop, episode$end_upper)
        risk_open <- TRUE
      } else {
        risk_open <- FALSE
        break
      }
    }
  }

  if (risk_open && last_obs > risk_start) {
    row_index <- row_index + 1L
    interval_rows[[row_index]] <- tibble::tibble(
      pid = pid_value,
      hhid = hhid_value,
      tstart_num = as.numeric(risk_start - first_obs),
      tstop_num = as.numeric(last_obs - first_obs),
      event = 0L
    )
  }

  if (length(interval_rows) == 0L) {
    tibble::tibble(
      pid = character(),
      hhid = character(),
      tstart_num = numeric(),
      tstop_num = numeric(),
      event = integer()
    )
  } else {
    dplyr::bind_rows(interval_rows)
  }
}

fit_ag_model <- function(episodes_df, followup_df, threshold) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      if (nrow(followup_df) == 0L) {
        stop("No follow-up records are available.")
      }

      followup_clean <- followup_df %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          first_obs = to_date_safe(first_obs),
          last_obs = to_date_safe(last_obs)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          !is.na(first_obs),
          !is.na(last_obs),
          last_obs > first_obs
        )

      if (nrow(followup_clean) == 0L) {
        stop("No valid positive-length follow-up records are available.")
      }

      ag_intervals <- purrr::map_dfr(
        seq_len(nrow(followup_clean)),
        function(i) {
          followup_row <- followup_clean[i, , drop = FALSE]
          person_episodes <- episodes_df %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              pid == followup_row$pid[1],
              hhid == followup_row$hhid[1]
            )

          build_one_person_ag_intervals(
            followup_row,
            person_episodes
          )
        }
      ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          is.finite(tstart_num),
          is.finite(tstop_num),
          tstop_num > tstart_num
        )

      if (nrow(ag_intervals) == 0L) {
        stop("No valid Andersen-Gill risk intervals were constructed.")
      }

      analysis_ag <- ag_intervals %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          covariate_df,
          by = c("pid", "hhid")
        )

      prepared <- prepare_cox_data(
        analysis_ag,
        final_covariates,
        cluster_variable = "pid"
      )

      if (length(prepared$covariates) == 0L) {
        stop("No final-model covariates are estimable in the AG data.")
      }

      formula_ag <- build_cox_formula(prepared$covariates)

      fitted <- fit_cox_safely(
        analysis_data = prepared$data,
        formula = formula_ag,
        cluster_variable = "pid",
        threshold = threshold,
        model_stub = "AG",
        model_name = "Recurrent events"
      )

      list(
        fit = fitted$fit,
        data = prepared$data,
        results = fitted$results
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message(
        "Ct ",
        threshold,
        ": Andersen-Gill model failed: ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        ". Continuing."
      )

      write_log(
        paste0(
          "Ct_",
          ct_label(threshold),
          "_AG_ERROR.txt"
        ),
        conditionMessage(e)
      )

      list(
        fit = NULL,
        data = tibble::tibble(),
        results = empty_cox_results()
      )
    }
  )
}

pretty_hazard_label <- function(term) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    stringr::str_starts(term, "drinking_water_binary") ~
      "Piped drinking water",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "utensils_washed_binary") ~
      "Utensils washed with piped water",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "food_storage_binary") ~
      "Food refrigerated",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "ndir_leave_binary") ~
      "Leaves Ndirande regularly",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "meat_freq_binary") ~
      "Meat frequency",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "fish_freq_binary") ~
      "Fish frequency",
    term == "days_out_day" ~ "Days left house",
    term == "cls_contactnum" ~ "Number of close contacts",
    term == "eat_atcafe" ~ "Eats at cafe",
    term == "water_treated" ~ "Household water treated",
    term == "hand_index" ~ "Hand hygiene index",
    term == "hours_in_house_num" ~ "Hours spent in house",
    term == "age_yr" ~ "Age",
    stringr::str_starts(term, "sex") ~ "Sex",
    term == "wealth_index_z" ~ "Wealth index",
    TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(term, "_", " ")
  )
}

# ========================================================================
# 18. RUN ONE Ct THRESHOLD
# ========================================================================

run_one_threshold <- function(sensitivity_file, threshold) {
  cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
  cat("RUNNING Ct <= ", threshold, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("============================================================\n")

  # PCR status
  pcr_df <- make_threshold_pcr(
    sensitivity_file = sensitivity_file,
    threshold = threshold
  )

  # Use the same follow-up denominator at every threshold.
  followup_df <- followup_reference %>%
    dplyr::filter(pid %in% unique(pcr_df$pid))

  # Episodes
  episodes_df <- build_episodes(pcr_df)

  # Burden
  burden <- calculate_burden(
    pcr_df = pcr_df,
    episodes_df = episodes_df,
    followup_df = followup_df,
    threshold = threshold
  )

  b <- burden$burden_summary

  # Ct 37.1 QC: informational only; never stop.
  if (abs(threshold - PRIMARY_CT) < 1e-8) {
    qc <- tibble::tibble(
      quantity = c(
        "Positive stools",
        "Positive participants",
        "Episode rows",
        "Observed-onset episodes",
        "Completed episodes"
      ),
      expected = c(
        PRIMARY_EXPECTED$n_positive_stools,
        PRIMARY_EXPECTED$n_positive_participants,
        PRIMARY_EXPECTED$n_episode_rows,
        PRIMARY_EXPECTED$n_observed_onset,
        PRIMARY_EXPECTED$n_completed
      ),
      observed = c(
        b$n_positive_stools,
        b$n_positive_participants,
        b$n_episode_rows,
        b$n_observed_onset,
        b$n_completed_episodes
      )
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        difference = observed - expected,
        matches = observed == expected
      )

    cat("\nPRIMARY Ct=37.1 QC — INFORMATIONAL ONLY\n")
    print(qc, n = Inf)

    readr::write_csv(
      qc,
      file.path(
        output_tables,
        "primary_Ct37p1_episode_reconstruction_QC.csv"
      )
    )

    message(
      "Ct=37.1 mean duration = ",
      round(b$mean_duration_days, 2),
      " days; primary analysis approximately ",
      PRIMARY_EXPECTED$mean_duration_days,
      "."
    )

    message(
      "Ct=37.1 median duration = ",
      round(b$median_duration_days, 2),
      " days; primary analysis ",
      PRIMARY_EXPECTED$median_duration_days,
      "."
    )

    message(
      "Ct=37.1 incidence = ",
      round(b$incidence_per_1000_person_days, 2),
      " per 1000 person-days; primary analysis approximately ",
      PRIMARY_EXPECTED$incidence_per_1000_pd,
      "."
    )

    if (!all(qc$matches)) {
      message(
        "Some Ct=37.1 QC counts differ from the original analysis; ",
        "all remaining thresholds will still run."
      )
    }
  }

  # Hazard models
  first_fit <- fit_first_event_model(
    episodes_df = episodes_df,
    followup_df = followup_df,
    threshold = threshold
  )

  ag_fit <- fit_ag_model(
    episodes_df = episodes_df,
    followup_df = followup_df,
    threshold = threshold
  )

  # Save threshold-specific datasets.
  label <- ct_label(threshold)

  saveRDS(
    pcr_df,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_PCR_series.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    episodes_df,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_episodes_df.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    burden$duration_episode_df,
    file.path(
      output_rds,
      paste0("Ct_", label, "_completed_episode_durations.rds")
    )
  )

  saveRDS(
    burden$person_time_df,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_person_time_df.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    burden$boot_results,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_bootstrap_results.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    first_fit$data,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_first_event_model_data.rds"))
  )

  saveRDS(
    ag_fit$data,
    file.path(output_rds, paste0("Ct_", label, "_AG_model_data.rds"))
  )

  cat("\nBURDEN / DURATION SUMMARY\n")

  print(
    b %>%
      dplyr::select(
        threshold,
        n_positive_stools,
        percent_stools_positive,
        n_positive_participants,
        n_positive_households,
        n_episode_rows,
        n_observed_onset,
        n_completed_episodes,
        mean_duration_days,
        median_duration_days,
        incidence_per_1000_person_days,
        person_time_prevalence_percent
      ),
    width = Inf
  )

  list(
    threshold = threshold,
    burden = b,
    first_hr = first_fit$results,
    recurrent_hr = ag_fit$results,
    episodes = episodes_df
  )
}

all_sensitivity_results <- purrr::map2(
  scenario_manifest$sensitivity_file,
  scenario_manifest$threshold,
  function(sensitivity_file, threshold) {
    tryCatch(
      run_one_threshold(
        sensitivity_file = sensitivity_file,
        threshold = threshold
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Ct ",
          threshold,
          " scenario-level error: ",
          conditionMessage(e),
          ". Continuing to next threshold."
        )

        write_log(
          paste0(
            "Ct_",
            ct_label(threshold),
            "_SCENARIO_ERROR.txt"
          ),
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        list(
          threshold = threshold,
          burden = tibble::tibble(threshold = threshold),
          first_hr = empty_cox_results(),
          recurrent_hr = empty_cox_results(),
          episodes = empty_episode_table()
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

primary_group_value <- function(values, thresholds) {
  primary_index <- which(abs(thresholds - PRIMARY_CT) < 1e-8)

  if (length(primary_index) == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  as.numeric(values[primary_index[1]])
}

direction_is_consistent <- function(hr_values, primary_hr) {
  finite_hr <- hr_values[is.finite(hr_values)]

  if (!is.finite(primary_hr) || length(finite_hr) == 0L) {
    return(NA)
  }

  if (primary_hr > 1) {
    return(all(finite_hr > 1))
  }

  if (primary_hr < 1) {
    return(all(finite_hr < 1))
  }

  NA
}

if (nrow(hazards_all) > 0L) {
  hazard_stability_summary <- hazards_all %>%
    dplyr::group_by(model, term, label) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      HR_primary = primary_group_value(HR, threshold),
      p_primary = primary_group_value(p, threshold),
      HR_min = if (any(is.finite(HR))) {
        min(HR, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      HR_max = if (any(is.finite(HR))) {
        max(HR, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      n_thresholds = sum(is.finite(HR)),
      n_significant = sum(is.finite(p) & p < 0.05),
      direction_consistent = direction_is_consistent(
        HR,
        primary_group_value(HR, threshold)
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(model, label)

} else {
  hazard_stability_summary <- tibble::tibble(
    model = character(),
    term = character(),
    label = character(),
    HR_primary = numeric(),
    p_primary = numeric(),
    HR_min = numeric(),
    HR_max = numeric(),
    n_thresholds = integer(),
    n_significant = integer(),
    direction_consistent = logical()
  )
}
```
